summary.text: Steve Gander is a Republican member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 1B, with a tenure beginning in 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Gander is an optometrist and a former mayor of East Grand Forks.

paragraphs.text: Steve Gander graduated from East Grand Forks Senior High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of North Dakota and received a Doctor of Optometry from the Illinois College of Optometry in 1987.
His career experience includes working as an optometrist.
He previously served as mayor of East Grand Forks and as an at-large city council member.
Gander succeeded Debra Kiel in District 1B and took office on January 14, 2025.
He was assigned to the Agriculture Finance and Policy and Human Services Finance and Policy committees for 2025 and 2026.
